people.name: Sarah Chen
people.story: I spent a decade debugging code until I realized my true passion was debugging business problems. Moving to Product allowed me to stay in tech while focusing on the 'why' instead of the 'how'. It was the best decision of my life.

people.name: Marcus Johnson
people.story: Coding was my foundation, but building a company is my legacy. I still write some code for my startup, but most of my days are spent on growth, strategy, and people.

people.name: Elena Rodriguez
people.story: I used to implement designs, now I create them. My background in React makes me a better designer because I understand the constraints of the browser.

people.name: David Kim
people.story: Monitoring pipelines was fun, but designing entire architectures is where the real magic happens.

people.name: Sophie Laurent
people.story: I loved the frontend, but I loved explaining it even more. Now I help thousands of devs learn through my articles and videos.

people.name: James Wilson
people.story: Software is just a tool for business. I now help companies optimize their entire workflow, not just their code.
